title: Eleven Seconds to Open a Page
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：access　|　正文 311 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 access 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: There was no ① access to the back of the shop except through the house, which my grandmother said was why the shop was never robbed and why she was never alone. The ② access to books, meaning the possibility of getting hold of them, was eleven miles away at the county library, and she went once, in 1961, said it had been worth the walk, and never went again.

In 1998 the village got ③ internet access — eleven houses at first, and my mother was one of the eleven — and the access cost eleven pounds a month, and she sat down at it at sixty-one and wrote to everybody she had lost.

The ④ access to the parish records, which she had wanted for thirty-one years, came free with the same machine in 2001, and she found eleven of the twelve things she was looking for and died in 2003 without the twelfth, and no access, she said, is ever really free.

In 2011 I ⑤ gained access to her account, which took eleven weeks and one letter; there were four hundred messages in it, and I read eleven and stopped. The ⑥ access was slow — eleven seconds to open a page — and she said the slowness was the best thing about it, because it made her choose.

You could ⑦ access the field from the lane until 1974, when the council put up a gate, and my grandmother said a gate is a wall with better manners. I ⑧ accessed the file eleven times in one week and have not opened it since. The ⑨ access she gave me, meaning the right to look at everything, was in a letter written in 1998 and read in 2003. The ⑩ access, meaning the door at the back of the shop, was bricked up in 2011, and the shop is a house, and the house is mine.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 通道；入口；进入的路径
B. n. （使用、接触、获取某物的）机会；权利
C. n. （网络的）接入；访问（速度、方式）
E. v. 访问；调取（文件、数据）
F. 固定搭配：access to ... 接触／使用……的机会
G. 固定搭配：gain / get access to ... 获得进入／使用……的权利
H. 固定搭配：internet access 互联网接入；上网

items.q: There was no access to the back of the shop
The access to books, meaning the possibility
The access to the parish records
I gained access to her account
The access was slow, eleven seconds
You could access the field from the lane
I accessed the file eleven times
The access she gave me, meaning the right
The access, meaning the door at the back

answers.why: access to the back of the shop 意为“通往店铺后间的通道”，除了穿过住房，没有别的路。
the access to books 意为“得到书的机会”，能借到书的地方在十一英里外的郡图书馆。
internet access 意为“互联网接入”，1998 年村里通了互联网，一开始只有十一户。
access to the parish records 意为“接触教区档案的机会”，她盼了三十一年才在 2001 年免费得到。
gain access to ... 意为“获得进入／使用……的权利”，2011 年我获准进入她的账号，花了十一周和一封信。
the access 意为“（网络的）接入、访问速度”，接入很慢，打开一页要十一秒。
access 是动词，意为“进入、到达”，1974 年以前你可以从那条小巷进入那块地。
accessed 意为“访问、调取（文件）”，我在一周里把那个文件调取了十一次，此后再没打开过。
the access 意为“（她给我的）权利、许可”，她给我的查看一切的权利，写在 1998 年的一封信里。
the access 意为“入口、通道”，指店铺后间那道门，2011 年被砌死了。

The access to books was eleven miles away at the county library, and she went once, in 1961.
In 1998 the village got internet access, eleven houses at first, at eleven pounds a month.
The access to the parish records, which she had wanted for thirty-one years, came in 2001.
In 2011 I gained access to her account, which took eleven weeks and one letter.
You could access the field from the lane until 1974, when the council put up a gate.
